about: Shared topology of the per document coverage (plan 43-03, D-43-07, D-43-08, D-43-09, D-43-11, D-43-14). The Python half (tests/test_coverage_counts.py, tests/test_coverage_endpoint.py) builds state.db and vectors.db from 'rows'; the PHP half (php/tests/Unit/CoverageTopologyParityTest.php, plan 43-05) reads 'expected.php'. Every expected number is counted by hand from this file, the derivation names the keys that count. doc_key is a label: the tests store sha256(label) as the key, '' is the sentinel of plan 43-16 (no key known, counts as a document of its own), null means the backfill has not asked yet. A label is the internal path of the file inside its storage, so two members of one share group carry the same label for the same file.

variants.name: gateway_unreadable
variants.about: D-43-16 with D-43-11 (plan 43-18): the container judges a gateway 422 as skipped/unreadable and acknowledges it, so the same verdict stands in oc_findling_file_state (phpOnlyRows). The PHP side counts the document there, with N1, in the denominator and in notReadable; the container leaves unreadable out of judged, otherwise the document would stand twice in the denominator. A topology of its own: group 0 = [51, 52] where every member carries the verdict, group 1 = [61, 62] where member 61 reads the file (N1), and the single storage 71.

variants.name: roots
variants.about: D-43-15 and D-43-17 (plans 43-21 to 43-23): the main topology plus two members of the same share in group 0. Member 14 mounts the share with the root projekt, so its internal path of a file is the share path without 'projekt/'; member 15 writes the share name in upper case (DATEN) with the root '', so its internal paths are those of 11. The share identities are those of StorageService::shareIdentities (host and share name folded, root apart). The extra rows carry the real document key of format 2 (DocKeyService::docKeyOf), computed by hand with the command in keyDerivation; the labels of the main rows stay labels, a key is compared with keys only. Everything not named here is the main topology, whose figures stay the same without this variant.
